title: Screenshot Metadata Schema
description: Display metadata for marketing screenshots captured by Playwright workflows. Used by the website to render the screenshots gallery dynamically.

title.description: Display title shown in screenshots gallery (20-40 chars). Examples: 'Dashboard', 'People Directory', 'Plugin Management'

category.description: Gallery section this screenshot belongs to. Must match one of the predefined categories.

dark.description: Name of dark-mode variant of this screenshot (if captured). Leave null if no dark variant exists. Example: 'dashboard-hero-dark'
